IN_FILE_IDENTITY_CROSSCHECK.why: load_case_fronts keys its {seed_ordinal: rows} dict off each row's in-file _seed_ordinal, not off the manifest. A duplicated or wrong in-file ordinal would silently collapse two seeds into one; the wrapper always builds exactly SEEDS_PER_CASE entries, so the loss would present as an empty seed rather than as valid=False. This check closes that path.
IN_FILE_IDENTITY_CROSSCHECK.VERDICT: every case loads exactly 30 distinct seeds; no silent collapse possible
